title: Improving our resume to land more interviews ✍️
description:
Does your resume match the job description you’re looking at? If it doesn’t that could be why you’re getting immediate rejections on your job applications. A job description is a company writing out what they’re looking for in an employee so your resume needs to SHOW that you do meet those requirements. #resume #resumebuilder #resumetips
